title: Hal min nasir
body:
hal min nasir hal min naser
kaun hai meri madad ko haazir
hal min nasir hal min naser
<<DIVIDER>>
asr ko goonji jab ye sada
larze sunkar arz o samaa
jaanta jo hai mujhko jaane
jo nahi jaanta wo pehchane
tum par haq ho mera zaahir
kaun hai meri madad ko haazir
hal min naser...
<<DIVIDER>>
nana mohamed nani khadija
baba ali maa fatema zehra
bhai hassan sardar e jina hai
khabze may mere kaun o makan hai
mera munkir haq ka kaafir
kaun hai meri madad ko haazir
hal min naser...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai hoo quran mai hoo emaan
munkir mera dushmane yazdan
nafse khuda hoo nafse nabi hoo
jaane nabi hoo mai bhi ali hoo
mai hoo jalaale haq ka mazhar
kaun hai meri madad ko haazir
hal min naser...
<<DIVIDER>>
subha se tumne dekhe nazare
khoon may doobe chand aur taare
nana nabi ke deen pe waare
jaan se jo thay mujhko pyare
koi raha na humdam o yawar
kaun hai meri madad ko haazir
hal min naser...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash mere akbar ki padi hai
uspe jawani roti khadi hai
phool sa jism aur naiza aur payka
tumne kiya ghar mera veeran
cheen liya kyun mujhse akbar
kaun hai meri madad ko haazir
hal min naser...
<<DIVIDER>>
lootli tumne meri kamayi
koi bacha na beta na bhai
hukme khuda se tumse lada hoo
khoon may dooba tanha khada hoo
zakhmi pyasa hoo mai musafir
kaun hai meri madad ko haazir
hal min naser...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumko koi ehsaas nahi hai
koi bhi mere paas nahi hai
behre madad abbas nahi hai
mujhsa koi be aas nahi hai
gheray hai sab mujhko kaafir
kaun hai meri madad ko haazir
hal min naser...
<<DIVIDER>>
girta hoo mai koi sambhale
zakhmon se koi teer nikaale
maa ki mere aayi sawaari
sar dene ki hai tayyari
asr ka hai hangaame aakhar
kaun hai meri madad ko haazir
hal min naser...
<<DIVIDER>>
jiska gharana saara kareem
tanha maalike zibhe azeem
khayam ta zahoore hujjat
hai wo faheem taalibe nusrat
hal min naser hal min naser
kaun hai meri madad ko haazir
hal min naser...
author: Faheem
